title: Getting started
subtitle: Learn how to create an account, set up your profile, and start using WorkZora.

cards.title: How to create a WorkZora account
cards.description: Learn how to sign up, choose your account type, and start using the platform.

cards.title: How to choose your account type
cards.description: Understand the difference between a client account and a freelancer account, and choose the option that fits your goals.

cards.title: How to complete your profile
cards.description: Add your photo, name, professional title, short bio, skills, portfolio, hourly rate, and work preferences.

cards.title: How to verify your email address
cards.description: Confirm your email address to activate your account and receive important platform notifications.

cards.title: How to set up your profile photo or avatar
cards.description: Upload a clear profile photo or choose an avatar that helps other users recognize you.

cards.title: How to navigate your dashboard
cards.description: Learn where to find your projects, messages, profile settings, notifications, and saved items.

cards.title: How to use search on WorkZora
cards.description: Find freelancers, projects, categories, and help articles using keywords and filters.

cards.title: How to update your account settings
cards.description: Change your personal information, password, email preferences, and notification settings.

cards.title: How to manage notifications
cards.description: Choose which updates you want to receive about messages, proposals, project status, and payments.

cards.title: How to keep your account safe
cards.description: Use a strong password, check suspicious messages, and follow basic safety recommendations on the platform.

cards.title: How WorkZora works for clients
cards.description: A quick overview of how clients can post projects, receive proposals, hire freelancers, and manage work online.

cards.title: How WorkZora works for freelancers
cards.description: A quick overview of how freelancers can create a profile, find projects, send proposals, and build their reputation.

cards.title: What to do after registration
cards.description: Follow the first steps after creating your account: complete your profile, explore categories, and start using the platform.

cards.title: Common beginner mistakes to avoid
cards.description: Learn what new users often miss when setting up their profile, posting a project, or sending their first proposal.
